fields.regle: Après un verbe introducteur au passé, les temps reculent d'un cran : présent → prétérit, prétérit → past perfect, will → would.

exercises.prompt: Rapporte au discours indirect : « I'm tired », she said.

accepted: She said she was tired
She said that she was tired

exercises.prompt: Rapporte au discours indirect : « I'll phone you tonight », he said.

accepted: He said he would phone me that night
He said that he would phone me that night

hints: will devient would, et tonight devient that night.

exercises.prompt: Rapporte au discours indirect : « We have finished », they told me.

accepted: They told me they had finished
They told me that they had finished

hints: Le present perfect recule au past perfect.

exercises.prompt: « I live in Ghent. » → He said he ___ in Ghent. (live)

accepted: lived

exercises.prompt: « I can't swim. » → She admitted she ___ swim. (can't)

accepted: couldn't
could not

exercises.source: "I am moving to Oslo next month," Rita said.
exercises.prompt: Rapporte la phrase en commençant par « Rita said ».

accepted: Rita said she was moving to Oslo the following month
Rita said that she was moving to Oslo the following month

hints: next month devient the following month.

exercises.source: He said me that the shop was closed.

accepted: He told me that the shop was closed
He said that the shop was closed

hints: say ne prend pas de complément direct de personne : tell si.

exercises.prompt: « I've lost my keys. » → She said she ___ her keys.

accepted: had lost

hints: Le present perfect recule d'un cran.

fields.regle: Ordres : tell somebody to + base. Questions rapportées : ordre sujet-verbe normal, sans do, avec if/whether pour les questions fermées.

exercises.prompt: Rapporte l'ordre : « Wait outside », the guard told us.

accepted: The guard told us to wait outside

exercises.prompt: Rapporte la question : « Where do you work? » she asked me.

accepted: She asked me where I worked

hints: Question rapportée : ordre normal, plus de do.

exercises.prompt: Rapporte la question : « Are you coming? » he asked.

accepted: He asked if I was coming
He asked whether I was coming

exercises.prompt: « Don't touch it! » → She warned me ___ touch it. (not to)

accepted: not to

hints: Ordre négatif : not to + base verbale.

exercises.prompt: « What time does it start? » → He asked what time it ___ . (start)

accepted: started

hints: Le présent recule, et l'auxiliaire disparaît.

exercises.source: "Please sit down," the nurse said to him.
exercises.prompt: Rapporte l'ordre en commençant par « The nurse asked him ».

accepted: The nurse asked him to sit down

hints: ask somebody to + base verbale, pour une demande polie.

exercises.source: She asked me where did I live.

accepted: She asked me where I lived

hints: Dans une question rapportée, on retrouve l'ordre sujet-verbe.

exercises.prompt: He asked ___ I had seen the film.

accepted: whether

hints: Question fermée rapportée : if ou whether.
